name: typegpu-inspector
description: TypeGPU Inspector monorepo: Zed extension, VS Code extension, language server, and runtime inspector.

scripts.build: pnpm --dir inspector build && pnpm --dir server build && pnpm --dir editors/vscode build
scripts.check: pnpm --dir server check && pnpm --dir inspector typecheck && pnpm --dir editors/vscode check
scripts.test: pnpm --dir server test && pnpm --dir inspector test
scripts.validate: pnpm check && pnpm test && pnpm test:browser && pnpm test:e2e && cargo check
